$Comment: Christmas Morning, the last part of Christmas: from the first moment of December 25th to the last
moment of January 10th, counted in UTC, so it ends the same moment Christmas does. The file name is
the event id. Its End falls before its Start, so a run crosses the new year and belongs to the year
it starts in. It runs on its own dates, so a server owner who moves Christmas in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json moves this one there too.
Content that waits for Christmas morning writes Season: Christmas_Morning, or reads
ziggfreedcommon:feature with Param Christmas_Morning_Live and Min 1 in a conversation.
Herald shows its start banner once to each player, the first time they are on the server from
Christmas morning on. It has no End banner: it ends with Christmas, whose own banner says goodbye.
/zigcalendar status Christmas_Morning shows what the server reads.
